source_data.prob_desc_description: Jzzhu has invented a kind of sequences, they meet the following property:You are given x and y, please calculate fn modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Output a single integer representing fn modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains two integers x and y (|x|, |y| ≤ 109). The second line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·109).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first sample, f2 = f1 + f3, 3 = 2 + f3, f3 = 1.In the second sample, f2 =  - 1;  - 1 modulo (109 + 7) equals (109 + 6).
